direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale is typical of noirs of the 70s, but the movie really used these world-building scenes to tell the story, and this makes the movie feel very slow and boring; The car chase sequence for the time period was revolutionary, but when compared to today, it very much feels like 'The Train Coming to the Station'; The micro scale is pretty standard for a 70s noir; The storytelling is not really good as it is pretty void and makes you not really care for the conflict or the characters; Tension is built poorly as the movie feels very dry

performance.comments: Plays the lead well and shows his acting ability, but it is something standard you would expect from one of Hollywood's best actors
Really just the sidekick character, but has pretty good chemistry with Hackman

cast.comments: Standard 70s noir actors; everyone plays their role fine and they do a decent job of telling the story

story.comments: The concept is a standard 70s noir about narcotics; The plot structure is pretty standard for a 70s noir, but the ending feels incredibly abrupt; There honestly isn't that much plot in this movie, as they try to stretch out the few plot points they have; Character writing is not really that good, as you don't really care for these characters and don't really get a picture of who they are, at least I didn't really care for who they are

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is pretty standard for the time; the symbolism is not really that good, as they try to paint these characters as morally corrupt but don't really do a good job of doing that, especially Hackman's character; the foreshadowing is what you would expect from a 70s noir

cinematography.comments: Pretty good for establishing the world, especially considering much of the movie is panning shots of what is going on; the cinematography during the chase sequence was good and made it entertaining

editing.comments: Pretty standard 70s noir, with a lot of choppiness

visual_effects.comments: The effects during the chase sequence were good and revolutionary for the time; but the use of guns and blood felt very tacky

review.pacing: Pacing is incredibly slow, as they stretch out the few plot points they have to make the runtime; the climax is incredibly fast, as the movie just ends abruptly
review.climax: Climax is somewhat entertaining, but it is incredibly fast and ends the movie abruptly
review.final_notes: I watched this half asleep on an airplane, so that might be half the reason I wasn't a huge fan of it
review.overall: Overall, a pretty boring 70s noir that stretches out whatever little plot it has to tell a story, a story where you don't really care for the conflict or its characters; while the car chase sequence may have been revolutionary for the time, compared to modern effects, it really feels like the 'The Arrival of a Train at La Ciotat' of car chases
